ipv-fingent-global-solutions-backend-dat.workDetails:
At Fingent, we believe that technology can make a meaningful difference to the lives around us. The lives of those who use it, the lives of those who build it and to society at large. We create and provide software which is beautiful, usable and compelling, to solve complex business challenges. We nurture smart people who bring out the best in themselves, their peers, and their clients.

About the Role

We are looking for a Hybrid Backend & Data Infrastructure Engineer to architect and scale the backend services and high-throughput data platforms that power our core products and analytical insights.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between software engineering, distributed systems, and data infrastructure. You will design high-performance microservices and APIs, orchestrate complex streaming and batch pipelines, automate cloud-native infrastructure, and solve hard distributed-systems challenges—such as multi-replica race conditions, state synchronization, and sub-second data processing.

Key Roles & Responsibilities

Backend & Microservices Engineering

Architect, build, and deploy low-latency, scalable APIs and microservices using modern Python (FastAPI, FastMCP, uv).

Integrate foundational AI/LLM models and external services (e.g., AWS Bedrock).

Define resilient service interfaces, API schemas, and data contracts between internal engineering teams.

Distributed Systems & Concurrency Management

Design robust state-management patterns to handle high-concurrency race conditions across worker pools, message queues, and database rows.

Implement distributed synchronization mechanisms (e.g., distributed locks/mutexes, idempotency keys, and optimistic/pessimistic locking strategies).

Ensure reliable execution, deduplication, and zero-data-loss guarantees across asynchronous task workers.

Data Infrastructure & Orchestration

Develop and maintain scalable job orchestration workflows for streaming and batch processing using Celery, Dagster, or Apache Airflow.

Design, optimize, and maintain relational datastores (PostgreSQL) and in-memory caches (Redis).

2Base Technologies is building out its marketing function, and this role is the entry point into the content team.

We are a custom software development company with over 16 years of delivery experience, working as an enterprise solutions partner for clients across the United States, the United Kingdom and other global markets. Our work spans AI implementation, custom software development, legacy system modernisation and operational transformation.

This is a writing role for someone at the start of their career who wants to become genuinely good at explaining technology in plain English. You will produce real published work from your first month, and you will be edited closely while you do it.

What This Role Exists to Do

The content team publishes to an audience of technical leaders and business decision-makers: CTOs and IT Directors who evaluate architecture decisions, and Founders, COOs and Operations leaders who are accountable for technology outcomes without a technical background of their own.

This role produces the first drafts that sit underneath that output. You take a written brief, do the reading, and deliver a draft that is clean, on topic, and written for the reader named in the brief. The brief comes to you. The voice is already defined. Your job is to write well inside both.

What You Will Own

First drafts of blog posts and long-form articles, written from briefs set by the Content and Thought Leadership Specialist

Client case studies and project write-ups, working from delivery team inputs

Social media copy for the 2Base company channels

Website page copy and updates

Research and source gathering behind longer pieces, including reading the technical material well enough to summarise it accurately

Publishing and scheduling support once a piece has cleared the quality gate

What You Will Not Own

The 2Base content voice: it is already defined and documented, and you write within it

Content briefs: the Content and Thought Leadership Specialist writes them, you write to them

SEO keyword selection: the Organic Growth and SEO Specialist sets this

Visual design of content assets: the Visual Designer owns this
